facing: toward viewer, front three-quarter angled slightly screen-left
sourceFrameResolution: See each enemy nativeCellSize; 512 canvas exports may be upscaled.
timingBasis: 260 ms per action; source poseAnimator.json defaultPlayMs 260

enemies.name: Wandering Soldier
enemies.adaptation: Sword and kite shield. Physical ranged uses thrown knife with sword sheathed.

enemies.name: Blight Hound
enemies.adaptation: Four-legged spiny diseased canine. Attack bite/lunge, counter snap, magic sickly breath, ranged physical spine spit, sweep tail/body, block crouch with armored spine toward threat. NO HUMAN ARMS or handheld weapons.

enemies.name: Husk Brute
enemies.adaptation: Faceless spherical stone-jointed bulky golem. Fist attack/counter, rune magic, physically thrown rock, sweeping arm, crossed rock forearms block.

enemies.name: Grave Wisp
enemies.adaptation: Floating ragged green spectral humanoid. Spectral talon attack, tendril counter/sweep, green necromancy, ranged physically hurled grave shard, folded spectral shroud block. Defeat collapsed shroud, no invented feet.

enemies.name: Wyrm Aspirant
enemies.adaptation: Reptilian warrior with curved sword, spiny armor and long red tail. Sword actions, fire magic, physical thrown spike, blade block. Keep reptilian digitigrade legs.

enemies.name: The Fell Warden
enemies.adaptation: Black armored red-caped warrior wielding long fiery poleaxe. Maintain poleaxe two-handed grips. Dark fire magic, thrown iron dart ranged, haft block.

enemies.name: Lantern Moth
enemies.adaptation: Six-legged moth with broad eye-pattern wings and glowing amber abdomen. Attack mandible dive, counter wing snap, magic lantern flare, ranged ejected physical chitin dart, sweep wings, block folded protective wings. Do not invent human arms. Defeated crumpled wings on ground.

enemies.name: Briar Hermit
enemies.adaptation: Ragged bark-covered forest hermit with twisted wooden staff. Staff attack, branch counter, amber nature magic, physical thrown thorn, root/staff sweep, bark and staff block.

enemies.name: Chain Scavenger
enemies.adaptation: Hooded ragged scavenger with hooked chain. Hook attack, chain counter, curse magic, ranged thrown hook on extended chain, chain sweep, wrapped-chain guard.

enemies.name: The Bell Keeper
enemies.adaptation: Large bell-helmet knight wielding bell-headed polehammer. Hammer attack, haft counter, bronze resonance magic, physical thrown small bell, hammer sweep, braced haft block.

enemies.name: The Thorn Matriarch
enemies.adaptation: Tall red-black thorn-root queen with staff. Thorn-limb attack/counter, crimson nature magic, physical thorn projectile, root sweep, woven thorn block. Keep root-based lower anatomy.

enemies.name: Gilded Knight
enemies.adaptation: Gold armored knight sword and ornate shield. Sword actions, gold magic, thrown knife ranged, shield block.

enemies.name: Court Surgeon
enemies.adaptation: Black plague-doctor hood and beak mask, curved bone sickle, sickly green lantern. Sickle attack/counter, green magic, thrown scalpel, sickle sweep, crossed tools block.

enemies.name: Stitched Hound
enemies.adaptation: Four-legged black-red armored stitched canine. Bite attack, snap counter, red curse breath magic, physical needle-spit ranged, tail/body sweep, crouched armored block. No human arms.

enemies.name: Court Marionette
enemies.adaptation: Purple puppet swordsman hanging from wooden crossbar and visible strings. Sword attack/counter/sweep, puppet magic, thrown needle ranged, sword guard. Preserve bar/string anatomy in every standing pose; collapsed puppet and fallen bar for defeat.

enemies.name: Living Armor
enemies.adaptation: Hollow moss-green dark armor, sword and shield. Sword attacks, green magic, thrown armor shard, shield block. Never add a visible human face.

enemies.name: Duelist of the Court
enemies.adaptation: Slim red-plumed metal knight with red cape and rapier. Rapier attacks/counters, red magic, thrown dagger, rapier sweep/parry block.

enemies.name: The Stitched King
enemies.adaptation: Massive pale stitched crowned humanoid with ragged red cape and huge meat cleaver. Cleaver attacks, blood magic, thrown cleaver fragment, wide cleaver sweep, cleaver/forearm block.

enemies.name: Mirror Scribe
enemies.adaptation: Masked silver-gold purple-plumed robed scribe with metallic quill. Quill attack/counter, mirror magic, physical thrown quill, quill sweep, reflective forearm guard.

enemies.name: Stitch Crab
enemies.adaptation: Large red armored crab with TWO large claws and multiple segmented walking legs. Claw attack/counter, red shell magic, physical chitin dart spit, claw sweep, crossed claws block. Preserve crab anatomy, never human legs.

enemies.name: The Glass Regent
enemies.adaptation: Slender icy crystalline crowned figure with long flowing shard cloak and thin rapier. Rapier actions, icy mirror magic, physical thrown glass shard, blade sweep, shard cloak guard.

enemies.name: The Marrow Organist
enemies.adaptation: Tall ragged red-white robed skeleton wearing organ pipes on back and holding staff. Bony hand/staff attacks, pale musical magic, physical thrown bone dart, staff sweep, folded pipe/staff guard. Preserve attached pipe array.

enemies.name: Ash Revenant
enemies.adaptation: Floating dark ash spirit, glowing eyes, rounded hood/head, tattered tapering lower body. Claw attack, counter, ember magic, physical cinder throw, tendril sweep, shroud block. No invented legs; defeated ash heap.

enemies.name: Ember-Starved Pilgrim
enemies.adaptation: Thin hooded brown ragged humanoid with glowing eyes. Clawed hands attacks, faint ember magic, thrown stone physical ranged, arm sweep, forearms block.

enemies.name: Valkyrie Shade
enemies.adaptation: Pale spectral female warrior with icy cyan feathered wings, long white hair and cyan spear. Spear attacks, cyan magic, physical javelin throw, spear sweep, folded wing/spear block.

enemies.name: Charred Colossus
enemies.adaptation: Huge black rock golem with glowing cracks and round shoulders. Fist attack/counter, molten magic, physically thrown rock, arm sweep, crossed stone forearms block.

enemies.name: Wyrm Lord
enemies.adaptation: Upright red-black dragon warrior with broad bat wings, long tail, claws, ember chest. Claw attacks, fire magic, physical thrown volcanic shard in claw, tail sweep, folded armored wings block.

enemies.name: The Blighted Valkyrie
enemies.adaptation: Dark armored spear warrior with broad pale cream feathered wings and red-black cape. Spear actions, blight magic, physical spear throw, spear sweep, wings and haft block.

enemies.name: Cinder Mantis
enemies.adaptation: Red-black mantis with two curved scythe forearms and insect legs/wings. Scythe attacks, ember magic, physical chitin dart launch, scythe sweep, crossed scythes block. No human hands or weapons.

enemies.name: Eclipse Cantor
enemies.adaptation: Dark blue hooded faceless robed mage with halo and blue orb staff. Staff attack/counter, blue magic, physical thrown silver needle, staff sweep, staff ward brace/block.

enemies.name: The Furnace Saint
enemies.adaptation: Red-gold armored robed saint with radiant sun head halo and hanging furnace censer. Censer attack/counter, flame magic, thrown physical hot coal, censer sweep, forearm/censer block.

enemies.name: The Hollow Astronomer
enemies.adaptation: Dark indigo hooded masked mage with gold astronomical rings and orb staff. Staff attack/counter, cosmic gold magic, physical thrown brass star, staff sweep, astral instrument block.

enemies.name: The Ashheart Dragon
enemies.adaptation: Red-black horned dragon, broad bat wings, long coiled tail, fiery chest. Preserve same upright dragon anatomy. Claw attack/counter, fire breath magic, physical volcanic stone spit, tail sweep, armored wing block.

notes: Each pose is independently painted. Projects expose whole-pose artwork layers, not invented anatomical rigs.
Automatic alpha/boundary checks do not constitute anatomy or playback approval.
Left-facing sheets in sheets/ are superseded by user direction and excluded.
